newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NYMEX crude prices sharply lower, Brent drops.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude prices sharply lower, Brent drops.

text.p: NYMEX crude futures prices were sharply lower in early Asian dealings on Wednesday following a bearish build in crude and gasoline stocks in the U.S..
NYMEX June crude futures -- trading on the out-of-hours ACCESS system -- was last traded at $21.05 per barrel, down 32 cents from the close of business on the New York floor.
The fall was attributed to American Petroleum Institute (API) data that showed a much larger than expected build in crude and gasoline.
API said crude stocks rose 6.94 million barrels when a 750,000-barrel build had been expected. Gasoline stocks surged 6.5 million, against expectations of 1.0 million.
"It's obviously API driven on ACCESS but the price fall is quite mild when you consider we have come up a long way," one broker said. June had gained almost $1 since last week.
However, brokers said June NYMEX was being supported at $21.00 -- the current intraday low -- with bids backed by healthy volumes.
